Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The equipment being procured under this bid is intended for use by high-performance athletes training at SAI NSSC Bengaluru. Therefore, bidders shall quote and supply a Pole Vault Landing System that strictly co nforms to the essential technical and performance requirements specified in the bid document and is suita ble for professional and high-performance Pole Vault training. The technical parameters, safety features, construction requirements, performance characteristics and oth er specifications indicated in the bid document constitute the essential requirements of the Buyer. The offe red Pole Vault Landing System shall strictly conform to, or exceed, the specified requirements relating to d imensions, construction, impact absorption, stability, safety, durability, weather protection, serviceability a nd intended high-performance usage. Equivalent or improved designs may be offered, provided that the offered equipment demonstrably meets or exceeds all the specified essential technical and performance requirements and is fully compatible with the complete Pole Vault Landing System. Any variation from the specified requirements shall be clearly in dicated by the bidder in the technical compliance statement. As per the bid conditions, the successful bidder shall be required to submit advance samples and/or releva nt technical literature for verification and approval prior to commencement of bulk supply, wherever requir ed by the Buyer. The submitted samples/product details shall be assessed for conformity with the specifie d technical requirements, quality standards, performance requirements, safety requirements and suitabilit y for high-performance training. Products that do not conform to the prescribed requirements or are found unsuitable for the intended use shall not be approved. Bidders are therefore requested to quote equipment meeting all the specified essential technical and perfo rmance requirements. Submission of products that fail to meet any of the essential requirements may resu lt in rejection of the offered item and cancellation of the award for the respective item(s), as applicable. The purchaser reserves the right to reject any product that does not conform to the specified essential tec hnical and performance requirements or fails to meet the required quality, safety, durability, stability, imp act-absorption, weather protection and serviceability requirements, irrespective of any claim of equivalenc e or similarity. The supplied Pole Vault Landing System, including the landing area, foam components, landing pad, weath er protection cover, galvanised platform, uprights and all accessories, shall be genuine, new and unused a nd shall conform to the specifications offered and accepted in the bid. Supply of counterfeit, fake, refurbis hed, duplicate or sub-standard products shall be treated as a serious breach of contract and such material shall be rejected outright. Appropriate action may be initiated against the seller in accordance with applica ble GeM provisions and contractual conditions. The bidder shall submit a point-wise technical compliance statement against all the prescribed specificatio ns, clearly indicating the offered specification and supporting manufacturer's technical literature/catalogue

reference wherever applicable. Any deviation, variation or proposed equivalent/improved feature shall be specifically highlighted by the bidder in the compliance statement. The successful bidder shall supply, assemble and install one complete Pole Vault Landing System at the co nsignee's premises. The complete system shall be inspected by the competent authority, and acceptance shall be subject to verification that all components conform to the prescribed technical specifications, are f ully compatible with each other and are functioning satisfactorily. The landing area, weather protection co ver, galvanised support platform and uprights shall be supplied as one complete and fully compatible integ rated system. The bidder shall submit valid documentary evidence of the specified World Athletics certification for the la nding system and uprights along with the technical bid, wherever certification is specified in the bid docum ent. Bidders shall provide a minimum warranty of one (01) year for all items covered under the bid from the dat e of successful installation/acceptance against manufacturing defects and defects in material/workmanshi p. In cases where the OEM/manufacturer's standard warranty is more than one year, the same shall be app licable and provided to the Buyer without any restriction. The bidder shall be responsible for delivery, assembly, installation and commissioning of the complete Pole Vault Landing System at SAI NSSC Bengaluru, including all necessary components and accessories re quired for making the system ready for use. . 17.
